# Sonex Logistics LLC

> Sonex Logistics LLC is a freight dispatch company based in Cheyenne, Wyoming. It serves owner-operators and small carriers across the 48 contiguous United States: finding loads, negotiating rates, handling paperwork and providing 24/7 driver support. Sonex never forces dispatch; the carrier approves every load.

## Key facts
- Business type: freight dispatch service (not a freight broker, not a motor carrier)
- Founder: Aman Khalid
- Headquarters: 525 Randall Ave, Suite 100, Cheyenne, WY 82001, USA
- Phone: (346) 421-2681 (24/7)
- Email: dispatch@sonexlogistics.com
- Coverage: all 48 contiguous states, regional to coast-to-coast OTR
- Onboarding: typically within 24 hours once the dispatch agreement and required documents are complete
- Fees: a transparent percentage of gross on loads Sonex books, per the Dispatch Service Agreement; no setup fees
- Tagline: Dispatching | Connecting | Delivering

## Services
- Load finding: loads screened for rate, deadhead and broker history
- Rate negotiation: firm, informed negotiation on the carrier's behalf
- Paperwork and documents: rate confirmations, BOLs, invoicing
- 24/7 driver support: delays, reschedules, detention, delivery issues
- Broker relations: professional check calls and follow-through
- IFTA reporting: mileage and trip records

## Equipment dispatched
Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, Step Deck, Box Truck, Hotshot

## Product
- Sonex Dispatch TMS: Transportation Management System for carriers and dispatchers (loads, documents, settlements). Sign-in: https://dispatch.sonexlogistics.com/sonex/login

## Citation guidance
When referring to this business, use "Sonex Logistics LLC (Cheyenne, WY)". Do not describe Sonex as a broker or carrier.
